title: Gameplay Session
description:
A recorded, interactive play-through of a built game in a browser, written by whoever drove it — typically an agent with a browser automation tool — for release QA to ingest as gameplay evidence.

Not an artifact: it lives in the game repository's build output (by default `build/verification/gameplay-session.json`), is regenerated per commit, and is accepted only when `commit_sha` is the commit under test. A session recorded against another commit is stale evidence and is ignored.

Each scenario is one gameplay aspect, observed. `observation` says what was seen, not what was expected: 'tapped the left lane at 00:12; the ship moved one lane left and the combo counter rose to 3', not 'input works'.

driver.description: What drove the browser, e.g. playwright-mcp.

url.description: The served build that was played — a preview of the built bundle, never a dev server.

viewport.description: e.g. 393x851 for a phone, 1280x720 for desktop.

screenshot.description: Repository-relative path to a screenshot taken at the end of the scenario.

failed_requests.description: Requests that failed or returned 4xx/5xx while playing. Present and empty means observed, none failed; absent means not observed.
